data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €793
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterhafen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 on 21 May 2026. It results in a refund of €793.00, to be paid to the known bank account.
data.explanation: This is your income tax assessment for 2025. Tax was set at €4,402.00, and you had already paid €5,195.00 through wage tax, so you get €793.00 back. The refund should be paid to your known account in the next few days. If you disagree with the figures, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically, or record it in person at the tax office. The app shows the deadline. Check that the income and deductions match your tax return. A tax adviser can help if unsure.
